resolution.note_plain: THE FIRST ENTRY IN THIS LEDGER — what we backtested and concluded, in plain words: We had AI read the filings of 64 beaten-up small companies (May 2025) and score how HONESTLY management communicates; the 13 most honest became a buy basket. A year later that basket returned +64.6% vs the small-cap index's +26.1%. This week we stress-tested the result: it beat 99.97% of ten thousand random picks (not luck), every input was public before the pick date (no cheating), and the one bookkeeping error we found had been working AGAINST us (honest accounting makes it +44.7 points). BUT: the test's pond was hand-picked extreme cases; on ordinary small caps the same method LOSES to the index. CONCLUSION: reading management honesty is a LANDMINE DETECTOR, not a treasure map — it caught 80-93% of the coming disasters (worth ~4-8 points/yr avoiding blowups in distressed stocks) but it does not pick market-beating winners in general. Our own prediction that the headline would shrink under scrutiny graded MIXED: the number survived, its meaning shrank.
